resources.string: Gemini live/model configuration, call routing, and accessibility services remain intentionally omitted in Phase 02 per PROJECT_CONTRACT.md. Use Microphone Setup & Self-Test to verify local 16 kHz PCM capture.
No active assistant model in Phase 02. Microphone self-test verifies local hardware only and is not an assistant answer.
Open Microphone Setup and Self-Test Screen
Stop conversation session and release hardware immediately

OmniVoice Rebuild needs microphone access to capture 16,000 Hz 16-bit mono PCM audio frames for local hardware verification and future voice turns. In Phase 02, audio never leaves the device, retention is off, and any temporary self-test playback clip is deleted immediately after verification or Stop.
HONESTY BOUNDARY: Microphone self-test verifies local acoustic capture & intelligible playback only. It is NOT an assistant answer; Gemini remains NOT_CONFIGURED.
